formulas.fund_liabilities_to_assets: Liabilities / Assets; same period end and accession
formulas.fund_equity_to_assets: StockholdersEquity / Assets; same period end and accession
formulas.fund_asset_growth_yoy: latest Assets / latest-known Assets from closest period end to 365 days before - 1; permitted gap 330-400 days
formulas.fund_annual_profit_margin: annual NetIncomeLoss / annual revenue; exact same start, end and accession; duration 330-380 days
formulas.fund_annual_profit_to_latest_assets: latest annual NetIncomeLoss / latest balance-sheet Assets; different periods allowed explicitly as a proxy
formulas.fund_annual_cfo_to_latest_assets: annual operating cash flow matching annual-profit start/end/accession / latest Assets; proxy
formulas.fund_balance_age_days: observation Date minus selected Assets period end, calendar days (not days since filing)
formulas.fund_annual_age_days: observation Date minus selected annual-profit period end, calendar days (not days since filing)

asof_rule: filed < observation Date AND period end <= filed; never use period-end as publication date
version_rule: Filter by asof first; latest period end then latest filed; conflicting same-day versions stay missing
matching: Balance sheet ratios require same end/accession; annual margin requires same start/end/accession and 330-380 day 10-K duration
missing: NaN retained; explicit 0/1 indicators; never drop a Date/symbol or impute using whole sample
raw_snapshot_scope: Current full companyfacts snapshots may include 2026 facts and later restatements; feature extraction strictly filters filed before historical observation dates through 2025
